name: asha-procgen
description: Dungeon procgen incubator for richer ASHA generated-level experiments.

scripts.batch:sample: npm run procgen -- batch generate --profile fixtures/batch-profiles/v2-sample.json --out-dir artifacts/samples/batch-v2 --seed 5201 --count 10
scripts.geometry:recovery: cargo run --quiet --release --manifest-path procgen-rs/Cargo.toml --bin asha-procgen -- batch generate --profile fixtures/batch-profiles/v2-sample.json --out-dir artifacts/samples/batch-v2 --seed 5201 --count 10 && npm run geometry:recovery:report
scripts.viewer:serve:regenerate: npm run baseline && npm run batch:sample && npm run build:viewer && node scripts/serve-viewer.mjs
scripts.viewer:smoke: npm run build:viewer && node scripts/smoke-voxel-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/smoke-voxel-inspection-frame.mjs && node scripts/smoke-viewer.mjs
scripts.policy:smoke: npm run build:viewer && node scripts/smoke-generation-config.mjs && node scripts/smoke-placement-policy-experiment.mjs && node scripts/smoke-geometry-policy-experiment.mjs && node scripts/smoke-corridor-realization-experiment.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:asha-boundary && npm run typecheck && npm run rust:test
scripts.verify: npm run check:asha-boundary && npm run typecheck && npm run publish:asha-smoke && node scripts/smoke-voxel-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/smoke-generation-config.mjs && npm run rust:check && npm run rust:test
